rows.query: Can I shift my practical to another lab next week?
rows.answer: Under §1.2 of P-AUTHORITY, students may report clashes through their class representative but may not request that a class be moved or cancelled; however, the lab in-charge reports laboratory closures for maintenance, and affected sessions are moved to another suitable laboratory or slot under §4.1 of P-LABS.

rows.query: Is there a limit on how many students can sit in the lab at once?
rows.answer: Under §2 Capacity, no more than 30 students may be present in a laboratory during a practical.

rows.query: Can the practical go ahead if nobody from staff is around to supervise?
rows.answer: Under §3 Supervision, a practical may run only when a faculty member or the lab in-charge is present.

rows.query: Are the labs shut on some weekends for servicing?
rows.answer: Yes, under §4 Maintenance, laboratories are closed for maintenance on the first Saturday of every month.

rows.query: Can I put my class in the midday break?
rows.answer: Under §2.2 Common lunch break, the hour from 13:00 to 14:00 is a common lunch break with no scheduled classes, and only the Dean may grant an exception.

rows.query: Is it okay to teach four periods without stopping?
rows.answer: Under §2.3 Consecutive teaching hours, no faculty member or section may be scheduled for more than three consecutive teaching hours without a break of at least one hour.

rows.query: Could I hold a session on Saturday morning?
rows.answer: Under §2.1 Working hours, teaching takes place Monday to Friday between 9:00 and 17:00; weekend classes require written approval from the Head of Department.

rows.query: What happens to the lecture I lose while I'm at a workshop abroad?
rows.answer: Under §2.4 Contact hours and credits, all contact hours must appear in the weekly timetable, which implies that missed hours due to absence require a make-up class to maintain the required contact hours.

rows.query: Dr. Iyer and I want to trade our Tuesday and Thursday lectures.
rows.answer: Under the relevant institute regulations, the policy specifies the following guidelines.

rows.query: Can a colleague take my class for me, or can I teach it over Zoom?
rows.answer: Under §3.4 Online and covered classes, a class may be held online, or taken by a colleague, only as a make-up arrangement and only with the approval of the Head of Department.

rows.query: The room is too small for my section, what does the rule say?
rows.answer: Under §4.2 Room capacity, a class must be held in a room whose capacity is at least the number of students registered in the section.

rows.query: I want to reserve the big hall for the coding club meetup.
rows.answer: Under §4.3 Event and room bookings, bookings of the auditorium, seminar halls or rooms for events, fests and meetings are handled by the Estate Office, not by the timetable office.

rows.query: Two of our courses are at the same time, who do we tell?
rows.answer: Under §5.1 Clash reports, students who find that two of their registered courses clash report it through their class representative.

rows.query: Will my medical reason be shown to the other faculty?
rows.answer: Under §6.1 Confidentiality, reasons given for unavailability, such as medical or family matters, are confidential and never published or shared.

rows.query: How many hours a week am I expected to teach at most?
rows.answer: Under §2.5 Teaching load, a full-time faculty member teaches at most sixteen contact hours per week, and a guest faculty member teaches at most eight contact hours per week.

rows.query: How many hours does a four credit course with a lab get each week?
rows.answer: Under §2.4 Contact hours and credits, a 4-credit course with a laboratory has three lectures and one two-hour practical, totaling five contact hours per week.

rows.query: Am I allowed to ask for my mornings to be kept free?
rows.answer: Under §3.1 Teaching preferences, faculty may state preferences about days and times, such as keeping mornings or a particular day free.

rows.query: Can a professor ask to move a class that belongs to someone else?
rows.answer: Under §1.2 Who may request changes, a faculty member may request changes only to their own classes.

rows.query: Does the timetable office also handle exam scheduling and events?
rows.answer: No, under §1.1 Scope, the regulations govern only the weekly teaching timetable of the department; examinations, events, and room bookings for non-teaching purposes are outside their scope. Under §4.3 Event and room bookings, such bookings are handled by the Estate Office.

rows.query: When are the midterms held?
rows.answer: Under §3.1 Examination weeks, mid-semester examinations are held in week 8.

rows.query: Can I move my class in the week before the midterm?
rows.answer: Under §3.1 Examination weeks, mid-semester examinations are held in week 8 and end-semester examinations in week 16 of the teaching calendar.

rows.query: How many times can I be put on exam hall supervision in one week?
rows.answer: Under §3.3 Invigilation duties, every faculty member is assigned at most two invigilation duties per examination week.

rows.query: A student was ill during the midsem, can they retake it?
rows.answer: Under §3.4 Make-up tests, a student who misses a mid-semester examination for a documented medical reason may take a make-up test within ten working days.

rows.query: Can I run an additional revision session just before the finals?
rows.answer: Under §3.5 Extra classes before examinations, extra revision classes in week 7 or week 15 are allowed only outside the regular timetable, must not exceed two hours per course, and must be announced to students at least three working days in advance.

rows.query: Our visiting lecturer wants a slot outside the times in her contract.
rows.answer: Under §2.1 Working hours, teaching takes place Monday to Friday between 9:00 and 17:00; weekend classes or slots outside these hours require written approval from the Head of Department.

rows.query: How early do we have to warn a visiting lecturer before rescheduling her talk?
rows.answer: Under §2 Notice period, a guest lecture may be moved only with at least one-week's notice and the written agreement of the guest-faculty member.

rows.query: How much can a visiting professor teach in a single day?
rows.answer: Under §3 Teaching load, a guest faculty member teaches at most eight contact hours per week, and never more than three hours on a single day.

rows.query: Which room does the visiting lecturer get, and who confirms it?
rows.answer: Under §4 Rooms, guest lectures are held in lecture rooms with a projector, and the Head of Department confirms the room when the window is fixed.

rows.query: I no longer need the seminar room I reserved, what should I do?
rows.answer: Under §4.3 Cancelling a booking, a booking that is no longer needed must be cancelled at least one working day in advance, so the room can be offered to others.
